sentences.text: This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.173/2021 registered at Police Station - Mohagarh, District Tikamgarh (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420 of IPC and 25/27 of Arms Act.
Applicant is in detention since 11.03.2024.
2. As per the prosecution story, applicant and other co-accused persons opened fire with their pistols and fraudulently took money from the complainant.
On the basis of information of complainant Police has registered the offence under the aforesaid Sections and arrested the present applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 11.03.2024.
He has been falsely implicated.
The offences are triable by JMFC.
Charge sheet has been filed.
He has no previous criminal history.
He further submits that co-accused persons have been enlarged on bail by the trial Court.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.

sentences.text: 4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
